1.text: Nuko Abafarisayo n'abanditsi bavuye i Yerusalemu baza aho Yesu ari baramubaza bati

2.text: “Ni iki gituma abigishwa bawe bataziririza imigenzo y'abakera, ntibajabike intoki mu mazi bagiye kurya?”

3.text: Na we arababaza ati “Namwe ni iki gituma mucumurira itegeko ry'Imana imigenzo yanyu?

4.text: Kuko Imana yavuze iti ‘Wubahe so na nyoko’, kandi iti ‘Ututse se cyangwa nyina bamwice.’

5.text: Ariko mwebweho muravuga muti ‘Umuntu wese ubwira se cyangwa nyina ati: Icyo najyaga kugufashisha nagituye Imana,umeze atyo ntahatwa kubaha se cyangwa nyina.’

6.text: Nuko ijambo ry'Imana mwarihinduye ubusa ngo mukomeze imigenzo yanyu.

7.text: Mwa ndyarya mwe, Yesaya yahanuye ibyanyu neza ati

8.text: ‘Ubu bwoko bunshimisha iminwa,Ariko imitima yabo imba kure.

9.text: Bansengera ubusa,Kuko inyigisho bigisha ari amategeko y'abantu.’ ”

11.text: Ikijya mu kanwa si cyo gihumanya umuntu, ahubwo ikiva mu kanwa ni cyo kimuhumanya.”

12.text: Maze abigishwa baramwegera baramubaza bati “Uzi yuko Abafarisayo barakajwe no kumva ayo magambo?”

13.text: Arabasubiza ati “Igiti cyose Data wo mu ijuru adateye kizarandurwa.

14.text: Nimubareke ni abarandata impumyi kandi na bo bahumye. Ariko impumyi iyo irandase indi zombi zigwa mu mwobo.”

17.text: Ntimuzi yuko ikintu cyose kigiye mu kanwa kijya mu nda kikanyura mu nzira yacyo?

18.text: Ariko ibiva mu kanwa biba bivuye mu mutima, ni byo bihumanya umuntu.

19.text: Kuko mu mutima w'umuntu ari ho haturuka ibitekerezo bibi: kwica no gusambana no guheheta, kwiba no kubeshyera abandi n'ibitutsi.

20.text: Ibyo ni byo bihumanya umuntu, ariko kurisha intoki zitajabitse mu mazi ntiguhumanya umuntu.”

21.text: Yesu arahava ajya mu gihugu cy'i Tiro n'i Sidoni.

22.text: Umunyakanānikazi aturuka muri icyo gihugu arataka cyane ati “Mwami mwene Dawidi, mbabarira, umukobwa wanjye atewe na dayimoni cyane.”

23.text: Ntiyagira icyo amusubiza. Nuko abigishwa be baramwegera baramwinginga bati “Musezerere kuko adutakira inyuma.”

24.text: Arabasubiza ati “Sinatumiwe abandi, keretse intama zazimiye zo mu muryango wa Isirayeli.”

25.text: Na we araza aramupfukamira aramubwira ati “Mwami, ntabara.”

26.text: Aramusubiza ati “Si byiza kwenda ibyokurya by'abana ngo mbijugunyire imbwa.”

27.text: Na we ati “Ni koko Mwami, ariko imbwa na zo zirya ubuvungukira bugwa buvuye ku meza ya ba nyirazo.”

28.text: Maze Yesu aramusubiza ati “Mugore, kwizera kwawe ni kwinshi, bikubere uko ushaka.” Umukobwa we aherako arakira.

29.text: Yesu avayo ajya ku Nyanja y'i Galilaya, azamuka umusozi aricara.

30.text: Abantu benshi baza aho ari, bazana abacumbagira n'ibirema, n'impumyi n'ibiragi n'abandi barwayi benshi, babarambika hasi imbere ye arabakiza,

31.text: bituma abantu batangara babonye ibiragi bivuga, ibirema ari bizima, abacumbagira bagenda, n'impumyi zireba, bahimbaza Imana y'Abisirayeli.

32.text: Yesu ahamagara abigishwa be arababwira ati “Mbabariye abo bantu kuko uyu munsi ari uwa gatatu turi kumwe, none ntibafite ibyokurya. Sinshaka kubasezerera batariye, isari itabatsinda ku nzira.”

33.text: Abigishwa baramubaza bati “Muri ubu butayu twakura he imitsima ingana ityo yo guhaza abantu bangana batya?”

34.text: Yesu na we arababaza ati “Mufite imitsima ingahe?”Baramusubiza bati “Ni irindwi n'udufi duke.”

36.text: Yenda iyo mitsima irindwi n'udufi, arabishimira, arabimanyagura, abiha abigishwa be, na bo babiha abantu.

37.text: Bose bararya barahaga, bateranya ubuvungukira busigaye, bwuzura ibitebo birindwi.

38.text: Abariye bari abagabo ibihumbi bine, abagore n'abana batabariwemo.

39.text: Asezerera abantu, yikira mu bwato ajya mu gihugu cy'i Magadani.
